item.description: A Melbourne Racing Club spokesman said the cup was stolen along with some bottles of wine and some other "low-value" items.

item.title: ABC News: Man joined fugitive on Queensland 'fishing trip', court told
item.description: A man accused of harbouring Melbourne fugitive Orijol Rukaj, who allegedly escaped custody at a funeral earlier this year, has told his lawyer they were in a remote part of Far North Queensland on a "boys' trip".

item.title: ABC News: 'Why are they selling pies?' What surprised O'Connell about AFL footy
item.description: Siofra O'Connell didn't know what to expect when she arrived in Australia from Ireland, from the bigger crowds at women's games to selling pies and chicken and chips.

item.title: ABC News: Minister says 'absolute majority' of WA councils are dysfunctional
item.description: More than two-thirds of Western Australia's local governments have had action taken against them by the local government inspector this year, ranging from governance challenges to serious misconduct.

item.title: ABC News: Mixed feelings over safer, slower Targa Tasmania rally
item.description: The Targa Tasmania tarmac rally is on again, with slower speeds and other safety measures in place after driver deaths — with some welcoming the changes, but others saying it has made it less competitive.

item.title: ABC News: Brisbane's Olympic stadium ahead of schedule but questions on costs swirl
item.description: The cost of early works for Brisbane's Olympic stadium remains hidden, while it has been revealed taxpayers will be slugged with the cost of the Gabba demolition.

item.title: ABC News: ARIAs red carpet: Sparkles, spikes and really big collars
item.description: Celebrities have started arriving at Sydney's Hordern Pavilion for the annual Australian music awards. Here's a look at some of the fashion.

item.title: ABC News: Rockliff says 'no surprise' if Hobart stadium cost exceeds $1.13b estimate
item.description: Tasmania's premier says it will come as "no surprise if there was some cost escalation" in the price of the planned Hobart stadium, citing the war in Iran as one factor.

item.title: ABC News: Woolworths shoppers call for answers over gift card draining issue
item.description: Frustrated shoppers who have lost hundreds of dollars from drained Woolworths gift cards are calling on the supermarket giant to explain what happened.

item.title: ABC News: Kakadu tour operator says waterfall closures led to his 'worst' dry season
item.description: Small businesses operating in Kakadu National Park saw mixed results this dry season, with one tour operator experiencing their "worst" trading period in a decade while another had double the number of camping visitors.

item.title: ABC News: Polling turns from bad to diabolical for Victorian Labor
item.description: The Coalition is now recording statewide support just above 30 per cent, and the gap between the Coalition and One Nation has been widening since June and July.

item.title: ABC News: State government dismisses national puberty blocker advice as 'ideological'
item.description: The parents of some young trans people are imploring the Queensland government to lift its ban on puberty blockers after a major national review found the treatment should remain an option.

item.title: ABC News: About 100 kids potentially exposed to TB case in childcare worker
item.description: An Adelaide childcare worker has been diagnosed with tuberculosis, potentially exposing about 100 young children at three sites to the bacterial infection.

item.title: ABC News: Danielle Wilson set to settle Federal Court lawsuit against Matt Wright
item.description: The widow of chopper pilot Chris "Willow" Wilson sued Matt Wright and the aviation safety watchdog following her husband's death in 2022. The parties have been locked in protracted legal proceedings for more than three years.

item.title: ABC News: Man accused of murdering 15-day-old baby pleads not guilty in Hobart court
item.description: A 23-year-old man accused of murdering a 15-day-old baby boy pleads not guilty in a Hobart court, with no application for bail made.

item.title: ABC News: AI is transforming the world and the US–China relationship
item.description: The ASEAN summit has become a platform for showing how economies are swept up in the newest and most potent form of US–China rivalry.
